{{Top|leg}}
A '''drop-sled''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Dropship/Legends|assault vehicle]] that was able to drop from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and deploy a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. It had an ablative coating for fast re-entry, and [[braking engine]]s to slow its descent.
